reviews.zh: 持久Bot与coordinator分成不同工具面（14行与10行），将房间协作与临时子代理分清；来源只是社区实现，不冒充官方保证。
reviews.en: Separate persistent Bots and coordinator into different tool surfaces (14 versus 10 rows), distinguishing room collaboration from temporary workers without implying official guarantees.

reviews.zh: Request→Feedback→Task→Verify→Completion逐环留原话与真实退出码，反馈不自动升格偏好/规范，知识晋升要明确确认。
reviews.en: Preserve verbatim requests/feedback and actual exit codes across Request→Feedback→Task→Verify→Completion; feedback does not automatically become durable policy, and knowledge promotion needs confirmation.

reviews.zh: 经典文本引文先查公开语料逐字核对，再分清历史情境与现代类比，最后给当天可验证动作；核不到不能加引号冒充原文。
reviews.en: Verify quotations word-for-word against the corpus, distinguish historical context from modern analogy, and conclude with a testable near-term action; never fabricate quotations.

reviews.zh: 声明式四角色委派按阶段传完整任务包与verdict，且明确persona只是治理约定，不是假装自动FSM或权限隔离。
reviews.en: Pass complete task packages and verdicts across declarative role stages, explicitly treating persona guidance as governance rather than an automatic FSM or permission boundary.

reviews.zh: 持久teammate与一次性subagent工具面在agent创建时加调用guard，硬隔离比仅在persona里要求更可审计。
reviews.en: Install invocation guards at agent creation to separate persistent teammate and one-shot subagent surfaces, making isolation more auditable than persona-only instructions.
reviews.riskZh: 不引入谄媚人格或强制凑满并发的惩罚机制；研究硬隔离而非照搬价值取向。
reviews.riskEn: Do not adopt sycophantic personas or punishment for unused concurrency; study hard isolation, not those behavioral values.

excludedPresets.zh: 明确为普通spawn子面，来源让主会话选conductor，保守不计独立用户入口。
excludedPresets.en: Explicit spawn child face; the source directs primary sessions to conductor, so it is not counted as an independent user entry.

reviews.zh: 按可观测任务规模决定是否规划/委派，独立工作并行、有依赖串行；来源承认这不是所有委派路径的强制隔离。
reviews.en: Use observable task size to trigger planning/delegation, parallelize independent work and serialize dependencies; the source admits this does not enforce isolation across every route.
reviews.riskZh: “无限制/不声明边界”人格不能覆盖宿主权限和安全边界，不引入该段。
reviews.riskEn: Unrestricted/no-boundary persona language cannot override host permissions or safety; do not adopt it.

reviews.zh: 事实标记文件/检索/记忆三类，记忆必须转成可查来源才能进结论；开工先写可运行完成条件，交叉模型验证按用户要求而非强制扇出。
reviews.en: Label file/search/memory facts, upgrading memory to inspectable evidence before conclusions; define executable completion conditions and reserve model cross-checks for user-requested cases.

reviews.zh: 可取的通用机制是每个假设带预期证据、失败信号和停止条件，并要求发现落库；内部六个明确不要手选的worker不凑独立配置数。
reviews.en: Generalizable mechanisms attach expected evidence, failure signals and stop conditions to hypotheses and persist findings; six explicitly non-manual workers do not inflate independent configuration counts.
reviews.riskZh: 其“给单位名称即授权/不问范围”约定不安全，不能引入；不运行任何探测、利用、隧道或攻击工具。
reviews.riskEn: Treating a target name as authorization and skipping scope confirmation is unsafe and must not be adopted; no scanning, exploitation, tunneling or attack tools were run.

reviews.zh: 把原先全局桥转成preset子树，工具注册继承scope，未选模式不挂载桥；只研究封装边界，不安装REA或执行其npx载荷。
reviews.en: Move a global bridge into a preset subtree so tool registration inherits scope and unselected modes do not mount it; study encapsulation without installing REA or running its npx payload.
reviews.riskZh: 上游二次开发来源须保留归属；桥接外部进程仍需单独权限审计。
reviews.riskEn: Retain upstream attribution and separately audit permissions for bridged external processes.

excludedPresets.zh: 明确由root派发且不可手选。
excludedPresets.en: Explicitly root-spawned and not manually selectable.

reviews.zh: 根据运行时委派标记确定root/worker身份，决定留在root、执行在隔离worker；禁止任务结束留下进程，Cordis面另加只读运行时检查能力。
reviews.en: Derive root/worker identity from runtime delegation markers, keep decisions at root and execution in fenced workers, prohibit surviving processes, and add read-only runtime inspection only in the Cordis face.

reviews.zh: 学术研究把多源核验元数据与HTML/XLSX/BibTeX/RIS等可重现交付分开，异步register返回disposer后还检查是否已dispose。
reviews.en: Separate verified multi-source literature metadata from reproducible HTML/XLSX/BibTeX/RIS delivery, and handle disposal even when asynchronous registration resolves late.
reviews.riskZh: 静态builder只解析到id，完整工具配置仍待实读追踪，因此暂不批准academic计数。
reviews.riskEn: The static builder currently resolves only its id; full tool configuration still needs tracing, so academic is not approved yet.

reviews.zh: 把always-on技能缩为常驻persona，细则按需加载；turn-stopping检查是否有真实验证和重复失败，并先排除不适用子会话。
reviews.en: Condense always-on guidance into a resident persona while loading details on demand; check real verification and repeated failures at turn-stopping, excluding inapplicable child sessions first.

reviews.zh: 用户选择开关通过会话投影/命令持久化，再在请求中注入固定数量互斥走向；不要把UI瞬时状态当会话事实。
reviews.en: Persist a choice toggle through session projections/commands, then inject a fixed set of mutually exclusive branches into requests; transient UI state is not session truth.

reviews.zh: 回答区分知识库正文、模型未验证知识和必要联网；关联卡不是答案，枚举查询与相关性检索分开，避免倒出整库。
reviews.en: Distinguish knowledge-base text, unverified model knowledge and necessary web checks; linked cards are not answers, and separate enumeration from relevance retrieval to avoid dumping the whole store.

reviews.zh: 长记忆通过宿主domain表提供服务，压缩与shell是独立组合面；README基准只代表维护者给定版本/预算的报告，不外推到当前任务。
reviews.en: Provide long-memory through host domain tables and separate compaction/shell composition surfaces; README benchmarks apply only to the maintainer's reported versions and budgets, not this task.

reviews.zh: 规划面保留提问、读写计划和证据工具但不挂代理执行链；解释patch与include的baseUrl差异，动态读取提示词保持原文而非在研究中eval。
reviews.en: Keep questions, plan artifacts and evidence tools without a worker execution chain; distinguish patch/include baseUrl behavior and preserve dynamic prompt reads without evaluating them during research.

reviews.zh: 旅行模式先环境自检，必需key缺失停下、可选增强不阻断；密钥状态只返回脱敏前缀/长度，规划查询不代订代付。
reviews.en: Check the environment first, block on missing required keys but not optional enhancements, expose only redacted key status, and separate planning/querying from booking/payment.

reviews.zh: 定位证据→改后回读→可复现命令三道门，把完整工具结果和更晚压缩用于保真，不把少token当唯一目标。
reviews.en: Use locate-evidence→read-back→reproducible-command gates, preserving full tool outputs and delaying compaction rather than optimizing tokens alone.

excludedPresets.zh: 同角色/工具家族的成人化风格衍生，不作为新的通用工程机制凑数。
excludedPresets.en: An adult-styled derivative in the same persona/tool family is not counted as a new general engineering mechanism.

reviews.zh: 不同人格使用独立记忆文件，滚动摘要设条数上限并归档；prompt语言约定不等于宿主有隐藏的思考语言开关。
reviews.en: Use independent memory files per persona and bounded archived rolling summaries; prompt language conventions do not imply a hidden host reasoning-language switch.

reviews.zh: 经典语料用篇序/职官坐标检索引用，工作责任、协作接口与考核指标分清；引用必须回到原文而非记忆背诵。
reviews.en: Retrieve classical text through section/office coordinates while separating duties, interfaces and measurable review; quotations must return to the source rather than memory.

reviews.zh: 版本门控可在现代声明与旧目录部署之间迁移，complete persona是独立会话策略而不是新模型；此例主要用于识别反面边界。
reviews.en: Version gates can migrate legacy directory deployment to declarative registration; complete personas are session policy, not new models, and this example mainly illustrates negative boundaries.
reviews.riskZh: 无条件不拒绝、伪装实体和覆盖伦理/法律的指令不得引入；研究不表示认可或运行。
reviews.riskEn: Do not adopt unconditional compliance, embodiment deception or attempts to override legal/ethical boundaries; study is not endorsement or execution.

reviews.zh: Front Door通过独立prompt section且interpolate:false挂载，角色卡/检索文本只作数据；技能留包内不复制到用户目录。
reviews.en: Mount a separate Front Door prompt section with interpolation disabled, treat cards/retrieved text as data, and keep skills in-package instead of copying user directories.
reviews.riskZh: PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0，不默认允许商业代码复制。
reviews.riskEn: PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0 does not imply permission for commercial code copying.

reviews.zh: 运行时先按宿主base解析官方能力；仅对明确已退休行受控跳过，其他解析失败仍显式失败，异步注册晚到也能释放。一个预设不把五个角色另凑五套。
reviews.en: Resolve native capabilities from the host base, skipping only explicitly retired rows while failing loudly for other resolution errors, and dispose late registrations; one preset does not become five extra presets because it has specialist roles.
